notes: O0: all four matched on the first or second write; the one blocker was the static helper sbuf_extend, which the other three call. It is in the same TU but outside the assigned four, so I implemented it as a same-TU helper (src/neatroff/sbuf/sbuf_extend.c, PASS at O0 and O1, and gcc inlines it at O2 so it has no target symbol there). Calling it required mextend's n and m parameters to be long (the target sign-extends them with movslq), which I fixed in the shared types/mextend.h. O1 and O2 needed no source changes: the same source matched at all three levels. sbuf_printf's va_list and 1024-byte buffer layout matched directly at every level.
